details:
This module enables you to configure a WIKI-like input filter that allows users to create links to site and external content.

The module doesn’t sufficiently prevent page titles being viewed for certain privately-accessible URLs.

This vulnerability is mitigated by the fact that an attacker must have access to use a text format with the Freelinking plugin configured to allow privately-accessible external URLs to be crawled. Site administrators may want to disable this functionality to evaluate any risk.
